tagline: A quiet, leafy village on the Asian Bosphorus shore — old wooden houses, a famous cucumber market, and a completely unhurried pace of life.

items.name: Çengelköy İskelesi Çay Bahçesi
items.description: Tea garden right at the waterfront with Bosphorus views. The classic village landing experience.

items.name: Çengelköy Balık Restoranları
items.description: Simple, excellent fish restaurants on the waterfront. Very local crowd — this is a real working Bosphorus village, not a tourist destination.

items.name: Çengelköy Salatalık (Cucumbers)
items.description: Çengelköy is famous throughout Istanbul for its cucumbers, sold from small carts and stalls around the village. An only-in-Istanbul curiosity.
items.tip: Buy them from a street vendor, add salt, and eat walking. This is Istanbul village life.

items.name: Çengelköy Village Walk
items.description: Wander the old village streets of Çengelköy past wooden houses, a small market, and the historic mosque. Unchanged for decades.

tips: Çengelköy is reached by bus from Üsküdar or by seasonal Bosphorus ferry service.
One of the most authentically preserved Bosphorus villages on the Asian side.
Combine with Beylerbeyi (south) and Vaniköy for a full upper Asian Bosphorus day.
The waterfront road north toward Kandilli is one of the most beautiful drives/walks in Istanbul.
